answer.book: A single Latin dissertation printed at Frankfurt an der Oder in 1684 (respondent Daniel Falck, presided over by J. C. Becmann), built as a title page, a dedication to Paul Fuchs, four chapters of numbered sections, and two addenda to Chapters I and II.
